findings.summary: The page doesn't explain what 'retirement age' means or whether the 3-year rule applies to someone who is 61 now and reaches that age while the money is in the fund. The reader calls this their most important question.
The calculator shows only the 5-year result. The reader never saw the amount at 6 or 7 years, so the ~80,000 ₪ figure for their chosen plan is their own guess.
Labels such as '123 ממקור / מחושב / מונח', 'חוקים וכללים · 10' and codes like KH-19 are not explained, so they mean nothing to the reader.
'Direct expenses… no overall cap was found' worried the reader. It isn't explained, and they wonder whether the fund can charge as much as it likes.
The bar chart has no key for the grey, yellow and green colours inside the bars, so the reader had to guess what they mean.
The 'left in your hands' result number is cut off by the arrow button.
The 'you deposited' result column shows no visible number.
The purple and grey underlining on numbers is not explained.
The paragraph about withdrawing after 5 years gives three numbers (50,719, 29,768 and 15,794) without making clear which one you actually get if you don't file for a refund.
When the employer stops paying in (for example, the reader retires before 6 years), the page's only answer is 'depends on the company'.
